Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE polished 2D monster collection icon for the existing Roblox game Grow a Monster.
Input image 1: CHARACTER DESIGN and pose reference. Preserve this exact monster and this exact costume.
Input image 2: ART STYLE ONLY, from the CURRENT in-game painted icons. Copy its crisp bold dark-plum contour, clean internal ink, colourful cel-shaded volume, glossy highlights and polished hand-painted sticker illustration language. Do not copy the deer, antlers, ears, big eyes, human hands, biped pose, shovel or clothes from image 2.
Subject: Longmaw, an earless and tailless black quadrupedal monster with exactly FOUR extremely long thin legs and four small black paws. Keep the elongated horizontal trunk, a SINGLE very steep SHARP triangular shoulder hump towering above its lowered head, long narrow tapered muzzle and an elongated tapering lower jaw. Use the moderately open Idle gape in image 1 with two rows of many separate ivory teeth. Keep TWO small WHITE eyeballs with tiny black pupils visibly recessed deep inside black sockets. The eyes must remain recognisably white even at small UI size. Keep body charcoal-black, with readable charcoal/slate and subtle plum highlights rather than a featureless black blob. This creature has no fur, no animal ears, no tail and no canine nose pad or nostrils.
Anatomy invariants: exactly four connected long legs and four visible paws, no human arms or hands, no extra limbs. Maintain the approved very long-legged, long-bodied, hunched proportions from image 1. Keep all costume accessories in their proper mounts. Do not turn it into a normal dog, wolf, deer, crocodile, biped or cute round animal. No horns, wings or extra head appendages.
Style: richly coloured illustrated mobile-game collectible, matching image 2; hand-drawn dark contour and dimensional cel shading, no photorealism, no low-poly 3D-render surface, no screenshot aesthetics.
Composition: ONE entire full-body character on a SQUARE canvas, mild front three-quarter view matching image 1, head toward image-left, readable four-legged silhouette. All four paws, full pointed hump, whole long jaws and headgear inside the frame, about 88 percent canvas height with clean margins. Keep the four negative spaces around the legs genuinely transparent. No crop.
Background: genuine TRANSPARENT alpha, including the space between legs and inside the open silhouette. No environment, floor, ground shadow, frame, border, white sticker halo, vignette, text, captions, labels, watermarks, UI panels, collage or extra characters. No blood or gore.
Role-specific costume: Broad warm straw hat with red/rust band and a small wheat sprig; sage green fitted work blanket/vest around the long body, brown leather harness with gold buckles, brown seed pouch on the flank, a small red neckerchief and tan foreleg cuffs. No handheld tool.
